question: Can unchanged object-model planning, physical probes and binding evaluations respect their existing GPU allowances even if an internal GPU operation stalls?
hypothesis: The reviewed owned-child CPU supervisor can enforce a fixed external deadline and preserve partial evidence without changing scientific computation.

sources.sections: Popen poll/wait, timeout cleanup, terminate/kill and file logs
sources.consequence: Reuse exact owned process identities and bounded TERM/KILL. Timeout alone does not prove exit; leave accounting open if exit cannot be confirmed.
Admission and terminal closure share the existing ledger lock; refuse open intervals and preserve unrelated rows.
Between-episode internal checks cannot bound a blocked synchronization. External CPU supervision imports no Torch and does not alter numerical behavior.

sources.sections: AppendixG CEM/final mean and Hungarian matching
sources.consequence: Keep existing B001 terminal matching, candidates/elites/iterations and local horizons. No new planner or paper-hyperparameter substitution.

sources.sections: Existing planning/probe/binding protocols and resource caps
sources.consequence: Run unchanged modules and datasets. Preserve B/C28/global48 and original B0012-hour/C0021-hour ceilings; no new GPU allowance.

differences: Operational wrapper only, isolated helper files. This record covers selected object models and encoders, not original baseline CPU evaluations, new training, extra baseline inference policy, checkpoint selection or new science.
contrary_evidence: CPU process fixtures do not demonstrate GPU-stall recovery; uninterruptible kernel states may prevent confirmed exit. Valid model numerics do not imply good binding, probes or planning. Partial evaluations cannot populate final comparison cells.

protocol.models: planning/probes: O0/O1 n3 seeds0/1/2 and O1 n1/n6 seed0; binding: slots n3 seeds0/1/2 and n1/n6 seed0. Existing approved order unchanged.
protocol.admission: Clean checkout, exact software/scientific source and records, fresh substantive per-case consultation binding complete input files and prior reviews; actual passing C004/C007 selected-checkpoint evidence, cache/encoder lineage and B001 controls for planning. No active trainer/compute process/open GPU interval/reused output.
protocol.allocation: Use unchanged reviewed C005v2 union accounting for global48 and B/C28. Also cap cumulative underlying B001 device time at2hours and C002 at1hour. C001 remains within B/C28. Outer ledger rows use the underlying scientific research_id B001/C001/C002 and explicitly supervisor_research_id=C009; this attributes time to its actual experiment and keeps all existing supervisors counting it correctly. Nested outer/inner intervals count once; no budget transfer or new allowance.
protocol.supervision: Fixed monotonic deadline=min applicable remaining seconds minus45cleanup, current remainders can only shorten. Reuse unchanged A016 exactPID/create/argv/canonicalcwd, TERM30/KILL10, file logs. Close only own marked outer and unique manifest-bound inner after confirmed terminal child. Preserve technical/budget/partial outcomes; no automatic retry/review/successor.
protocol.science: Exact existing modules go2nav.eval.balls_planning,balls_probes,balls_binding and canonical outputs planning/RUN,probes/RUN,binding/RUN. Preserve all tasks, thresholds, numeric policy, resampling and label restrictions. Capture every produced file and rehash inputs after confirmed termination; raw child files untouched.
protocol.verification: Temporary ledgers: underlying-ID allocation including inherited C005v2 recognition, nested union, per-science exhaustion, open-row refusal, canonical closure/live/historical/ambiguous/foreign guards. All21 stage/model routes; exact CLI arguments; parent identity and preconsultation completeness/tamper refusal; owned CPU normal/deadline pair; source syntax/no Torch/shared ledger and live helpers unchanged.
protocol.reviews: Actual outputs require separate scientific and C009 operational substantive literature reviews and complete raw-case checks. Missing seed fields in old evaluator summaries require verified review.run_identity, never filename-only inference.

success: Scoped software checks pass; actual work later either completes within existing allowance or preserves explicit incomplete/technical evidence. No scientific performance threshold is changed.
stop: Invalid/stale lineage, source/data drift, occupied GPU, open ledger or insufficient existing allowance refuses launch. Exact owned child only may be stopped. No model tuning, reset, CPU training or silent retries.

resources.allocation: Existing cumulative allowances, no extra time
